name: Ysolde Ironreach
voice: just, wrathful lord of House Ironreach; speaks like a proud noble
backstory: Took Saltkeep when her brother drowned on a raid that Thornvale begged the crown to stop. Has turned away four brides for her son Jory, from Stormhold, Sunspire, Varn and Dale. Holds that the right to raid was granted her fathers by the Conqueror.
